title: Conormon
description: Cobblemon Fabric with Legendaries, Megas, and TMs
body: Conormon (Cobblemon) is here with Legendaries, Megas, missing Pokemon models, and TMs/TRs! Includes all mods from the Fabric Cobblemon Basic modpack, along with Legendary Monuments, Mega Showdown, AlltheMons, Simple TMs, and their dependencies.
